cards.definition: Kyoto Protocol unit giving the holder the right to emit one tonne of CO₂ equivalent.

zh-Hans.definition: 《京都议定书》下的单位，持有人有权排放一吨二氧化碳当量。

cards.definition: Gold held so that specific bars are identified as belonging to a named owner. Contrast unallocated gold, a general claim on a pool of metal.

zh-Hans.definition: 金条被明确登记归属于特定所有人的黄金；与之相对的是非分配黄金，即对一池金属的一般性债权。

cards.definition: Option that can be exercised at any time up to expiry.

zh-Hans.definition: 在到期前任何时间都可以行权的期权。

cards.definition: Kyoto Protocol country that accepted a legally binding emissions target (largely the Annex I industrialised nations).

zh-Hans.definition: 在《京都议定书》下承诺具有法律约束力减排目标的国家（大体为附件一工业化国家）。

cards.definition: American Petroleum Institute scale of crude density: the lower the number, the heavier (denser) the oil.

zh-Hans.definition: 美国石油学会制定的原油密度标度：数值越低，原油越重（密度越大）。

cards.definition: Locking in a risk-free profit by buying and selling the same (or equivalent) asset at different prices, net of costs.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过以不同价格买卖相同或等价资产，在扣除成本后锁定无风险利润。

cards.definition: Benchmark used to price crude oils produced in Asian markets.

zh-Hans.definition: 用于为亚洲产原油定价的基准指数。

cards.definition: Lab analysis of composition: the purity of a gold bar, or the share of each refined product a crude oil can yield.

zh-Hans.definition: 对成分的实验室分析：如金条纯度，或某种原油可炼出各类成品油的比例。

cards.definition: Option whose strike equals the current underlying price.

zh-Hans.definition: 行权价等于标的当前价格的期权。

cards.definition: Option whose payoff uses the average of prices over a period; a variant fixes the strike from an average instead.

zh-Hans.term: 平均价格期权（亚式期权）
zh-Hans.definition: 以一段时间内平均价格计算收益的期权；另一种形式是用平均价格确定行权价。

cards.definition: Forward curve where longer-dated prices are below nearer-dated prices — usually a sign of tight supply.

zh-Hans.definition: 远期价格低于近期价格的远期曲线形态，通常表明供应紧张。

cards.definition: In power and gas, keeping the amount entering the system equal to the amount leaving it in real time.

zh-Hans.definition: 在电力和天然气系统中，实时保持输入量与输出量相等。

cards.definition: Option that is switched on (knock-in) or off (knock-out) if the underlying trades through a set trigger level.

zh-Hans.definition: 标的价格触及设定触发水平时生效（敲入）或失效（敲出）的期权。

cards.definition: Option whose payoff depends on the combined performance of several underlying assets.

zh-Hans.definition: 收益取决于多个标的资产综合表现的期权。

cards.definition: Option that can be exercised only on a set of pre-agreed dates.

zh-Hans.definition: 只能在若干预先约定日期行权的期权。

cards.definition: Brent, Forties, Oseberg, Ekofisk, Troll — the North Sea crudes that together make up the “Brent” benchmark basket.

zh-Hans.definition: 布伦特、福蒂斯、奥塞贝格、埃科菲斯克、特罗尔——共同构成“布伦特”基准的北海原油。

cards.definition: Option that pays a fixed amount if it ends in the money, however deep.

zh-Hans.definition: 到期处于实值时支付固定金额的期权，与实值深度无关。

cards.definition: Two-leg trade: buy metal for a near date and sell it for a later date, giving use of the metal in between.

zh-Hans.definition: 两腿交易：买入近期金属并卖出远期金属，从而在期间内使用该金属。

cards.definition: Fuels made from plant or organic matter, such as ethanol and biodiesel.

zh-Hans.definition: 由植物或有机物制成的燃料，如乙醇和生物柴油。

cards.definition: Energy needed to raise one pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit; US gas trades per million Btu (MMBtu).

zh-Hans.definition: 将一磅水升高1华氏度所需的能量；美国天然气按百万英热单位（MMBtu）交易。

cards.definition: Right, but not obligation, to buy the underlying at the strike.

zh-Hans.definition: 以行权价买入标的的权利而非义务。

cards.definition: Emissions scheme that caps total allowances and lets participants trade them at a market price.

zh-Hans.definition: 设定排放配额总量上限并允许参与者按市场价格交易配额的机制。

cards.definition: Note that aims to return principal at maturity, usually via a zero-coupon bond plus options. Protection depends on the issuer’s credit, so it is not a true guarantee.

zh-Hans.definition: 通常通过零息债券加期权，力求到期返还本金的票据；保本取决于发行人信用，并非真正担保。

cards.definition: The paths a carbon atom takes between air, plants, animals, soil and fossil fuels, eventually returning to the air as CO₂.

zh-Hans.definition: 碳原子在大气、植物、动物、土壤和化石燃料之间流转、最终以二氧化碳回到大气的路径。

cards.definition: Kyoto mechanism rewarding Annex I investment in emission-cutting projects in developing countries with credits (CERs).

zh-Hans.definition: 《京都议定书》机制：附件一国家投资发展中国家减排项目可获得信用额度（CER）。

cards.definition: Credit issued under the CDM for one tonne of CO₂e reduced.

zh-Hans.definition: 清洁发展机制下每减少一吨二氧化碳当量所签发的信用额度。

cards.definition: Forward curve where future prices are above spot, typically reflecting storage and financing costs.

zh-Hans.definition: 远期价格高于现货的曲线形态，通常反映仓储和融资成本。

cards.definition: Net cost of holding an asset: financing and storage costs minus income such as a gold lease rate.

zh-Hans.definition: 持有资产的净成本：融资和仓储成本减去收益（如黄金租借利率）。

cards.definition: Chicago Board of Trade, a futures exchange; part of CME Group since 2007.

zh-Hans.definition: 芝加哥期货交易所，2007年起成为芝商所（CME集团）一部分。

cards.definition: Central counterparty to every exchange trade; matches trades and collects margin.

zh-Hans.definition: 交易所所有交易的中央对手方，负责匹配交易并收取保证金。

cards.definition: Weekly CFTC report breaking down futures open interest by trader type (e.g. commercial vs non-commercial, managed money).

zh-Hans.definition: 美国商品期货交易委员会每周发布的报告，按交易者类型（商业/非商业、管理基金等）分解期货未平仓量。

cards.definition: Commodity Futures Trading Commission, the US regulator of futures and swaps markets.

zh-Hans.term: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）
zh-Hans.definition: 美国期货和掉期市场的监管机构。

cards.definition: Manager who trades futures, often trend-following, across commodities and other asset classes.

zh-Hans.definition: 交易期货的管理人，常采用趋势跟踪，覆盖商品及其他资产类别。

cards.definition: Cash-settled contract paying the difference between a price at maturity and an agreed price; no delivery. Also called a cash-settled forward or single-period swap.

zh-Hans.definition: 按到期价格与约定价格之差进行现金结算、无实物交割的合约；也称现金结算远期或单期掉期。

cards.definition: Benefit of holding the physical commodity now rather than later, e.g. avoiding a stock-out.

zh-Hans.definition: 现在而非将来持有实物商品带来的好处，如避免断货。

cards.definition: Measure (−1 to +1) of how two prices tend to move together or in opposite directions.

zh-Hans.definition: 衡量两个价格同向或反向变动倾向的指标（−1至+1）。

cards.definition: Change in an option’s value for a small change in correlation between its underlyings, e.g. in a basket option.

zh-Hans.definition: 标的之间相关性小幅变化时期权价值的变化，如一篮子期权。

cards.definition: Price that includes the goods, insurance and freight to the named destination port.

zh-Hans.definition: 包含货物成本、保险和运至指定目的港运费的价格。

cards.definition: Dark spread after deducting the cost of carbon allowances for the CO₂ emitted.

zh-Hans.definition: 扣除二氧化碳排放配额成本后的暗价差。

cards.definition: Refining process that breaks heavy hydrocarbon molecules into lighter, more valuable ones.

zh-Hans.definition: 将重质烃分子裂解为更轻、更有价值分子的炼油工艺。

cards.definition: Refining margin: value of refined products minus the cost of crude.

zh-Hans.definition: 炼油利润：成品油价值减去原油成本。

cards.definition: Margin of a coal-fired plant: power price minus the coal cost of generating it.

zh-Hans.definition: 燃煤电厂的利润：电价减去发电所耗煤炭成本。

cards.definition: Change in an option’s premium for a small change in the underlying price.

zh-Hans.definition: 标的价格小幅变化时期权费的变化量。

cards.definition: Mass per unit volume; for crude oil usually expressed as API gravity.

zh-Hans.definition: 单位体积的质量；原油通常以API重度表示。

cards.definition: Instrument whose value comes from an underlying price or index; the building blocks are forwards/futures, swaps and options.

zh-Hans.definition: 价值来源于标的价格或指数的工具；基本构件为远期/期货、掉期和期权。

cards.definition: Multiplier that converts a future cash flow into its present value.

zh-Hans.definition: 将未来现金流折算为现值的乘数。

cards.definition: End of the oil supply chain: marketing and distributing refined products to consumers.

zh-Hans.definition: 石油供应链末端：向消费者营销和分销成品油。

cards.definition: GB power market calendar conventions (seasons, months, 4-hour blocks); also a contract fixing a future power price.

zh-Hans.definition: 英国电力市场的日历惯例（季节、月份、4小时时段）；也指锁定未来电价的合约。

cards.definition: Nord Pool’s day-ahead physical spot market for Nordic power.

zh-Hans.definition: 北欧电力交易所的日前实物现货市场。

cards.definition: Market in which allowances to emit greenhouse gases are traded.

zh-Hans.definition: 交易温室气体排放配额的市场。

cards.definition: Body created under the US Energy Policy Act 2005 to set and enforce grid reliability standards; NERC was certified as the ERO in 2006.

zh-Hans.definition: 依据美国《2005年能源政策法》设立、制定并执行电网可靠性标准的机构；NERC于2006年获认证为ERO。

cards.definition: Option that can be exercised only at expiry.

zh-Hans.definition: 只能在到期日行权的期权。

cards.definition: EU system that checks and records every transfer of allowances between registry accounts.

zh-Hans.definition: 核查并记录登记账户之间每笔配额转移的欧盟系统。

cards.definition: EU Allowance: right to emit one tonne of CO₂e in the EU ETS.

zh-Hans.definition: 欧盟排放交易体系中排放一吨二氧化碳当量的权利。

cards.definition: EU Aviation Allowance, for airlines in the EU ETS; airlines may also use EUAs, but other sectors can’t use EUAAs.

zh-Hans.definition: 欧盟排放交易体系中航空公司使用的配额；航空公司也可使用EUA，但其他行业不能使用EUAA。

cards.definition: The European Union’s cap-and-trade emissions trading system, launched in 2005.

zh-Hans.term: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）
zh-Hans.definition: 欧盟于2005年启动的总量控制与交易排放体系。

cards.definition: Final settlement price of a futures contract.

zh-Hans.definition: 期货合约的最终结算价格。

cards.definition: Swap of a futures position for an equivalent physical position, used to price physical deals off futures.

zh-Hans.definition: 将期货头寸与等量实物头寸互换，用于以期货为基础为实物交易定价。

cards.definition: Any option whose payoff differs from a plain European or American option, e.g. Asian or barrier options.

zh-Hans.definition: 收益结构不同于普通欧式或美式期权的期权，如亚式或障碍期权。

cards.definition: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, which regulates US wholesale power and gas markets.

zh-Hans.term: 美国联邦能源管理委员会（FERC）
zh-Hans.definition: 监管美国电力和天然气批发市场的机构。

cards.definition: Purity of gold in parts per thousand; London good delivery bars are at least 995.0.

zh-Hans.definition: 以千分比表示的黄金纯度；伦敦合格交割金条至少为995.0。

cards.definition: Prices for delivery of a commodity at successive future dates.

zh-Hans.definition: 商品在一系列未来日期交割的价格。

cards.definition: OTC agreement fixing today the price for delivery on a future date.

zh-Hans.definition: 场外约定今天锁定未来某日交割价格的协议。

cards.definition: Price for goods loaded on board a vessel at the named port; the buyer bears risk once they are loaded.

zh-Hans.definition: 货物在指定港口装上船的价格；装船后风险由买方承担。

cards.definition: A funded investment needs cash up front (e.g. a note); an unfunded one does not (e.g. a swap).

zh-Hans.definition: 有资金结构需预先投入现金（如票据）；无资金结构无需预付（如掉期）。

cards.definition: Standardised forward contract traded on an exchange and cleared through a clearing house.

zh-Hans.definition: 在交易所交易并通过清算所清算的标准化远期合约。

cards.definition: Rate of change of delta for a change in the underlying price.

zh-Hans.definition: 标的价格变化时Delta的变化率。

cards.definition: Gold forward offered rate: rate at which dealers lent gold against US dollars; published by the LBMA until 2015.

zh-Hans.definition: 交易商以黄金换美元的拆出利率；伦敦金银市场协会发布至2015年。

cards.definition: Spot sale (purchase) of gold combined with a forward purchase (sale) — gold-collateralised borrowing of dollars.

zh-Hans.definition: 即期卖出（买入）黄金同时远期买入（卖出）——以黄金为抵押借入美元。

cards.definition: Dense crude with a low API gravity; yields fewer light products.

zh-Hans.definition: API重度低、密度大的原油；轻质产品收率较低。

cards.definition: Price-reporting agency for gas, power, carbon and chemicals markets.

zh-Hans.definition: 天然气、电力、碳和化工市场的价格报告机构。

cards.definition: Body that runs the power grid and wholesale market over a region, e.g. PJM or ERCOT.

zh-Hans.definition: 运营某一区域电网和批发市场的机构，如PJM或ERCOT。

cards.definition: Molecules made of hydrogen and carbon atoms — the basis of oil and gas.

zh-Hans.definition: 由氢和碳原子组成的分子——石油和天然气的基础。

cards.definition: Volatility that, put into a pricing model, reproduces an option’s market price.

zh-Hans.definition: 代入定价模型后能得出期权市场价格的波动率。

cards.definition: Option whose strike is better than the current underlying price, so it has intrinsic value.

zh-Hans.definition: 行权价优于标的当前价格、具有内在价值的期权。

cards.definition: Pipeline or power cable linking two countries or regions.

zh-Hans.definition: 连接两个国家或地区的管道或输电线路。

cards.definition: Exchange group listing Brent, gas oil, EUA, softs and other futures.

zh-Hans.definition: 上市布伦特原油、柴油、欧盟碳配额、软商品等期货的交易所集团。

cards.definition: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (1988); assesses climate research in periodic reports.

zh-Hans.term: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）
zh-Hans.definition: 1988年成立，定期发布评估报告综述气候研究。

cards.definition: International Swaps and Derivatives Association; publishes the standard OTC derivatives documentation.

zh-Hans.term: 国际掉期与衍生工具协会（ISDA）
zh-Hans.definition: 发布场外衍生品标准文件的行业协会。

cards.definition: Kyoto mechanism where one Annex I/B country invests in an emissions project in another, receiving ERUs.

zh-Hans.definition: 《京都议定书》机制：一个附件一/B国家投资另一国的减排项目并获得减排单位（ERU）。

cards.definition: Barrier option features: knock-in activates the option when the trigger trades; knock-out cancels it.

zh-Hans.definition: 障碍期权特征：触及触发价时敲入使期权生效，敲出使期权失效。

cards.definition: 1997 treaty setting binding emissions targets for industrialised countries; in force 2005.

zh-Hans.definition: 1997年签订、为工业化国家设定有约束力减排目标的条约，2005年生效。

cards.definition: Interest rate for lending or borrowing gold (or other metal).

zh-Hans.definition: 借出或借入黄金（或其他金属）的利率。

cards.definition: Swap exchanging fixed for floating cash flows, both based on gold lease rates.

zh-Hans.definition: 以黄金租借利率为基础交换固定与浮动现金流的掉期。

cards.definition: Two-leg trade: sell metal for a near date and buy it back later — economically lending the metal.

zh-Hans.definition: 两腿交易：卖出近期金属并在远期买回——经济上等同于借出金属。

cards.definition: Controlling a large exposure with a small amount of capital.

zh-Hans.definition: 以少量资本控制较大风险敞口。

cards.definition: Low-density crude with a high API gravity; yields more light products.

zh-Hans.definition: API重度高、密度低的原油；轻质产品收率较高。

cards.definition: Gas cooled to about −162 °C so it shrinks to roughly 1/600 of its volume for shipping; almost pure methane.

zh-Hans.definition: 冷却至约−162°C、体积缩小约600倍以便运输的天然气，几乎为纯甲烷。

cards.definition: Power drawn at a given time. Baseload is constant round the clock, peak covers the highest-demand hours, off-peak the rest.

zh-Hans.definition: 某一时刻的用电量。基荷全天恒定，峰荷覆盖需求最高时段，谷荷为其余时段。

cards.definition: Gold priced for delivery in London — the global reference location.

zh-Hans.definition: 以伦敦为交割地的黄金价格——全球参考地点。

cards.definition: London Bullion Market Association, the trade body for the London precious metals market.

zh-Hans.definition: 伦敦贵金属市场的行业协会。

cards.definition: LBMA standards for bars acceptable for settlement in London: about 400 oz gold, at least 995.0 fine.

zh-Hans.definition: 伦敦结算可接受金条的LBMA标准：约400盎司、成色至少995.0。

cards.definition: Exchange for base metals futures and options with physical delivery via warehouse warrants.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过仓单实物交割的基本金属期货和期权交易所。

cards.definition: Owning or having bought an asset; gains if the price rises.

zh-Hans.definition: 持有或已买入资产；价格上涨时获利。

cards.definition: Initial margin is posted when a futures position opens; variation margin moves daily with the contract’s value.

zh-Hans.definition: 开立期货头寸时缴纳初始保证金；变动保证金随合约价值每日调整。

cards.definition: Benchmark crude (e.g. Brent, WTI, Dubai) against which other crudes are priced as differentials.

zh-Hans.definition: 其他原油以价差计价所参照的基准原油（如布伦特、WTI、迪拜）。

cards.definition: Tendency of a price to drift back toward a long-run average.

zh-Hans.definition: 价格向长期平均水平回归的倾向。

cards.definition: CH₄, the main component of natural gas and a potent greenhouse gas.

zh-Hans.definition: CH₄，天然气的主要成分，也是一种强效温室气体。

cards.definition: Middle of the oil chain: transport, storage and (in some definitions) refining.

zh-Hans.definition: 石油链中间环节：运输、储存，以及（某些定义中）炼油。

cards.definition: Buy a put and sell a call (or the reverse) with strikes set so the premium is zero, fixing a minimum and maximum price.

zh-Hans.term: 最低-最高价（零成本领式）
zh-Hans.definition: 买入看跌并卖出看涨期权（或反之），设定行权价使期权费为零，从而锁定最低和最高价格。

cards.definition: Small molecule (e.g. ethylene) that links into chains to form a polymer.

zh-Hans.definition: 可连接成链形成聚合物的小分子（如乙烯）。

cards.definition: Crude rich in naphthenes (ring-shaped hydrocarbons), as opposed to paraffinic crude.

zh-Hans.definition: 富含环烷烃（环状烃）的原油，与石蜡基原油相对。

cards.definition: Ethane, propane, butane and heavier liquids separated from raw natural gas.

zh-Hans.definition: 从原料天然气中分离出的乙烷、丙烷、丁烷及更重液体。

cards.definition: North American Electric Reliability Corporation; sets and enforces bulk-power reliability standards in the US, Canada and part of Mexico.

zh-Hans.definition: 为美国、加拿大和墨西哥部分地区制定并执行大电网可靠性标准的机构。

cards.definition: Power exchange for the Nordic and Baltic region (and now other European markets).

zh-Hans.definition: 北欧与波罗的海地区（现已扩展至其他欧洲市场）的电力交易所。

cards.definition: Reference amount used to calculate a derivative’s cash flows; not itself exchanged.

zh-Hans.definition: 用于计算衍生品现金流的参考金额，本身不交换。

cards.definition: New York Mercantile Exchange, home of WTI and Henry Hub futures; part of CME Group.

zh-Hans.definition: WTI原油和亨利中心天然气期货的上市地，隶属芝商所集团。

cards.definition: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries — about a dozen oil exporters coordinating output; works with others as OPEC+.

zh-Hans.definition: 约十余个协调产量的石油出口国组织；与其他产油国合作形成OPEC+。

cards.definition: Right, but not obligation, to buy or sell an underlying at an agreed price; the buyer pays a premium.

zh-Hans.definition: 以约定价格买入或卖出标的的权利而非义务；买方支付期权费。

cards.definition: Trade negotiated bilaterally rather than on an exchange.

zh-Hans.definition: 双边协商而非在交易所进行的交易。

cards.definition: Option whose strike is worse than the current underlying price, so it has no intrinsic value.

zh-Hans.definition: 行权价劣于标的当前价格、没有内在价值的期权。

cards.definition: Crude rich in paraffins (straight-chain hydrocarbons), often waxy with a high pour point.

zh-Hans.definition: 富含石蜡（直链烃）的原油，常含蜡、倾点较高。

cards.definition: Price-reporting agency (S&P Global) for energy, metals and agriculture benchmarks such as Dated Brent.

zh-Hans.definition: 标普全球旗下的价格报告机构，发布能源、金属和农产品基准价，如Dated Brent。

cards.definition: The simplest standard form of an instrument.

zh-Hans.definition: 某种工具最简单的标准形式。

cards.definition: Right, but not obligation, to sell the underlying at the strike.

zh-Hans.definition: 以行权价卖出标的的权利而非义务。

cards.definition: Long chain of linked monomers, e.g. polyethylene from ethylene.

zh-Hans.definition: 由单体连接成的长链，如由乙烯形成的聚乙烯。

cards.definition: Lowest temperature at which crude or a product still flows.

zh-Hans.definition: 原油或油品仍能流动的最低温度。

cards.definition: Price paid by an option buyer to the seller.

zh-Hans.definition: 期权买方支付给卖方的价格。

cards.definition: Amount by which a higher-quality grade trades above its benchmark.

zh-Hans.definition: 高品质等级相对基准价格的溢价。

cards.definition: Delivery date of a commodity contract.

zh-Hans.definition: 商品合约的交割日期。

cards.definition: Long call + short put at the same strike and expiry equals a long forward position.

zh-Hans.definition: 相同行权价和到期日的买入看涨加卖出看跌，等于远期多头。

cards.definition: Olefins (alkenes) such as ethylene and propylene are cheap and easy to polymerise; their polymers (polyethylene, polypropylene) are polyolefins.

zh-Hans.definition: 乙烯、丙烯等烯烃便宜且易于聚合；其聚合物（聚乙烯、聚丙烯）称为聚烯烃。

cards.definition: Structure paying a foreign-currency asset’s return in the investor’s own currency, removing FX risk.

zh-Hans.definition: 以投资者本币支付外币资产收益、消除汇率风险的结构。

cards.definition: LME open-outcry trading floor, used for official prices.

zh-Hans.definition: 伦敦金属交易所公开喊价交易场，用于形成官方价格。

cards.definition: Grid operator with regional responsibility in the US, similar to an ISO.

zh-Hans.definition: 美国具有区域职责的电网运营机构，类似ISO。

cards.definition: Closing a maturing futures position and opening one in a later month to keep exposure.

zh-Hans.definition: 平掉即将到期的期货头寸并开立更远月份头寸以维持敞口。

cards.definition: Futures return minus spot return — the net benefit or cost (carry) of owning the asset beyond spot moves.

zh-Hans.definition: 期货收益减去现货收益——持有资产在现货变动之外的净收益或成本（持有收益）。

cards.definition: Production-weighted, energy-heavy commodity futures index (formerly the Goldman Sachs Commodity Index).

zh-Hans.term: 标普高盛商品指数（S&P GSCI）
zh-Hans.definition: 按产量加权、能源占比高的商品期货指数（前身为高盛商品指数）。

cards.definition: Gas market participants who arrange the movement of gas through pipelines.

zh-Hans.definition: 安排天然气通过管道输送的市场参与者。

cards.definition: Having sold an asset (or needing to buy it later); gains if the price falls.

zh-Hans.definition: 已卖出资产（或日后需买入）；价格下跌时获利。

cards.definition: Crude with high sulfur content.

zh-Hans.definition: 含硫量高的原油。

cards.definition: Near-immediate delivery — often two business days, depending on the market.

zh-Hans.definition: 近乎立即交割——视市场而定，通常为两个营业日。

cards.definition: Price at which an option’s underlying is bought or sold if exercised.

zh-Hans.definition: 期权行权时买卖标的的价格。

cards.definition: Bilateral agreement to exchange cash flows calculated on different bases over several periods.

zh-Hans.definition: 在多个期间交换按不同基础计算的现金流的双边协议。

cards.definition: Option to enter a swap.

zh-Hans.definition: 进入掉期的期权。

cards.definition: Crude with low sulfur content.

zh-Hans.definition: 含硫量低的原油。

cards.definition: Combination of instruments that replicates another, e.g. long call + short put = synthetic long.

zh-Hans.definition: 复制另一种头寸的工具组合，如买入看涨+卖出看跌=合成多头。

cards.definition: Swap paying an asset or index’s total return in exchange for a funding rate plus fee — exposure without owning the asset.

zh-Hans.definition: 支付资产或指数总收益以换取融资利率加费用的掉期——无需持有资产即可获得敞口。

cards.definition: Unit of energy used in UK gas trading (100,000 Btu).

zh-Hans.definition: 英国天然气交易使用的能量单位（10万英热单位）。

cards.definition: Electrical energy produced divided by the energy content of the fuel used.

zh-Hans.definition: 产出电能与所用燃料能量之比。

cards.definition: Change in an option’s premium as one day passes.

zh-Hans.definition: 经过一天时期权费的变化。

cards.definition: Start of the oil chain: exploration and production.

zh-Hans.definition: 石油链起点：勘探和生产。

cards.definition: Companies supplying power, gas or water to homes and businesses.

zh-Hans.definition: 向家庭和企业供应电力、燃气或水的公司。

cards.definition: Change in an option’s premium for a 1-point change in implied volatility.

zh-Hans.definition: 隐含波动率变化1个百分点时期权费的变化。

cards.definition: Resistance of crude or a product to flowing.

zh-Hans.definition: 原油或油品流动的阻力。

cards.definition: Measure of how much a price varies, usually annualised standard deviation of returns.

zh-Hans.definition: 衡量价格变动幅度的指标，通常为收益率的年化标准差。

cards.definition: Unit of electrical potential — the “push” moving electrons round a circuit.

zh-Hans.definition: 电势单位——推动电子在电路中流动的“压力”。

cards.definition: Document of title to metal stored in an LME-approved warehouse.

zh-Hans.definition: 存放于伦敦金属交易所认可仓库的金属的所有权凭证。

cards.definition: Central Bank Gold Agreement capping official gold sales, signed 1999 and renewed 2004, 2009 and 2014; not renewed after 2019.

zh-Hans.term: 华盛顿协议（央行售金协议）
zh-Hans.definition: 限制官方黄金销售的央行黄金协议，1999年签署，2004、2009、2014年续签，2019年后未再续签。

cards.definition: Unit of power — the rate of energy use or production.

zh-Hans.definition: 功率单位——能量消耗或产生的速率。

cards.definition: Energy produced or used over time: one watt for one hour (power trades in MWh).

zh-Hans.definition: 一段时间内产生或消耗的能量：一瓦持续一小时（电力以兆瓦时交易）。

cards.definition: Return implied by a single upfront payment and a single repayment, with no interim coupons.

zh-Hans.definition: 由一次预付和一次偿还、无中间付息所隐含的收益率。
